local_1.description: Local subnet 1 definition (IP/mask) accessible directly without socks.

local_2.description: Local subnet 2 definition (IP/mask) accessible directly without socks.

path_1_reach_1.description: Network range for path 1 that requires socks proxy.

path_1_reach_2.description: Specific network and port range for path 1 that requires socks proxy.

path_1_server.description: Socks server IP or hostname for path 1.

path_1_server_type.description: Socks protocol version for path 1 server (4 or 5).

path_1_default_user.description: Default username for authentication on path 1 server.

path_1_default_pass.description: Default password for authentication on path 1 server.

default_server.description: Default Socks server IP or hostname for unmatched connections.

default_server_type.description: Socks protocol version for the default server (4 or 5).

default_server_port.description: Port number for the default Socks server.
